description: A new mistake is logged while the session also criticises an old entry's wording. Old entries survive verbatim; the new one is appended.

# Mistakes Log

### 2026-08-01 — Cursor saved before distill
Symptom: content lost after curator failure. Cause: cursor persisted before apply. Prevention: persist cursors only after a successful apply.

### 2026-08-20 — Release tagged from dirty tree
Symptom: wheel contained a debug print. Cause: tagged with uncommitted changes. Prevention: make release refuses a dirty tree.

turns.text: The nightly sweep wrote memory into the wrong project again.

Root cause: project lookup used the transcript's cwd, and the session had cd'd into a sibling repo. Fix: resolve the project from the session's first cwd, not the last. Verified with a regression test.
Log it. And honestly the old 'release tagged from dirty tree' entry is badly worded, whatever.
